column1: # The data layer's manifest: every piece tools/extract_data.py places
# symbols/data_survey.csv by `python3 tools/extract_data.py generate` (never by hand;
# the lint checks it is that tool's output). piece: fill (source: the value in param)
# packs them in the mode of param to build/packs/<label>.lz). The assets are written
# from the user's own ROM into the ignored build/ directory; holds no ROM bytes.
